entities.summary: Glandas Marie Erick Toussaint is a Haitian clergyman and bishop for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Jacmel. He was ordained in 1994. He was appointed Auxiliary Bishop of Port-au-Prince, Haiti, and Titular Bishop of Senez in 2011, and then Bishop of Jacmel in Haiti in 2018.
